description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - The Collective Agreement entered into between Nestle Lanka PLC, Kurunegala Factory, Colombo 10 and other part Inter Company Employees Union Dehiwala - The Collective Agreement entered into between Bata Shoe Company of Ceylon Ltd. Ratmalana and other Part Wanija Ha Karmika Sewaka Sangamaya Colombo 02 (E Only)
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a collective agreement between a private company (Nestle Lanka PLC) and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory publication of a legally binding agreement, regulatory compliance requirements, and operates under the authority of specific legislation (Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131).
